# Agentql

AgentQL is a suite of tools designed to connect AI agents to the web, enabling web interaction and structured data extraction through a specialized query language.

Category: Other. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/agentql/.

## Actions

- **Create Remote Browser Session**: Create a remote browser session.
- **Get Usage Details** (read-only): Retrieve subscription usage details for the current api key, including usage limits and billing period.
- **Query Data** (read-only): Query structured data as json from a web page using an agentql query or natural language prompt.
